name: umbriel
title: Umbriel
description: Inspect and control the Umbriel Wayland compositor: outputs, virtual outputs, windows, workspaces, scratchpads, layers, keyboard layouts, screencasts, and keybinds. All changes are runtime-only and never edit the Umbriel config. Requires the umbriel CLI and a running Umbriel session.
author: xwaleedahmad

commands.name: outputs
commands.title: Outputs
commands.subtitle: Inspect and manage monitors
commands.description: List connected outputs, enable or disable them, control DPMS, and copy monitor details.

commands.name: windows
commands.title: Windows
commands.subtitle: Inspect and manage windows
commands.description: Browse windows grouped by monitor and workspace, then focus, warp the cursor to, close, or kill the selected window.

commands.name: workspaces
commands.title: Workspaces
commands.subtitle: Manage workspaces and layouts
commands.description: Browse workspaces by output, switch between them, reorder them, move them between outputs, and change their runtime layout.

commands.name: scratchpads
commands.title: Scratchpads
commands.subtitle: Manage scratchpad windows
commands.description: Browse configured scratchpads and toggle them by name.

commands.name: layers
commands.title: Layers
commands.subtitle: Inspect layer-shell surfaces
commands.description: Browse layer-shell surfaces with their output, layer, namespace, geometry, anchors, and keyboard interactivity.

commands.name: keyboard-layouts
commands.title: Keyboard Layouts
commands.subtitle: Inspect keyboard layouts
commands.description: Show configured keyboard layouts, the active layout, and cycle to the next layout.

commands.name: screencast
commands.title: Screencast
commands.subtitle: Share and follow windows or outputs
commands.description: Select a window or output to share, follow the focused window or output, stop following, or clear the current screencast target.

commands.name: virtual-outputs
commands.title: Virtual Outputs
commands.subtitle: Create and destroy virtual monitors
commands.description: Create a virtual output with an optional mode and destroy virtual outputs. Physical outputs cannot be destroyed.

commands.name: keybinds
commands.title: Keybinds
commands.subtitle: Browse configured keybinds
commands.description: Read keybinds from the Umbriel config and included files, grouped by the action sections reported by umbriel msg --help.
